completion_data.completion_summary: Corrected all four drifted release/environment docs: workflows README reduced to a pointer stub, RELEASE_SETUP.md matrix wording and archive paths fixed, ENVIRONMENT_SETUP.md Python floor/casing/Nix prose corrected, and a new NixOS post-publish verification recipe added to BASIC_INSTALLATION.md.

memory_candidates.content: When a doc references config files that live at a different directory level than the doc's own cd-based instructions establish (e.g. flake.nix/.envrc at repo root vs. code/ subdirectory the doc's cd targets), a literal string substitution (fixing only the filename) is insufficient -- the surrounding cd chain must be re-derived to match where the referenced files actually live, and any downstream steps that assumed the old cwd (e.g. running scripts that live under code/) need a bridging cd added back in. Treat a 'fix this stale path' task as a cwd-flow audit across the whole subsection, not a single string edit.

When a plan's own verification step is a grep for a literal string that also appears in the explanatory prose next to a code snippet, write the prose to avoid repeating the exact substring (e.g. 'set PIP_USER to 0' instead of repeating 'PIP_USER=0'), or the verification grep will over-match. Reword prose rather than weaken the verification.
